# parry

> Your countermove for any message. A mobile app that helps you reply or reach out, in any app, in your tone.

parry helps you describe a situation, paste a message, drop a screenshot, or speak it, then pick a tone and get four ready-to-send replies in seconds. Works for replies and for messages you're trying to start. Currently launching on iOS; Android is on the roadmap.

## Features
- 5 built-in tones: Casual, Professional, Supportive, Witty, Assertive
- 1 custom tone preset on the free tier; up to 4 with Pro
- Voice input with transcription
- Image and screenshot input

## Privacy
- parry does not store your conversations on its own servers
- Messages are sent to Anthropic (the AI provider) only to generate replies
- Anthropic may retain them up to 30 days for safety review, then deletes them
- Your messages are never used to train AI models
- No accounts: no sign-in or registration exists, even for Pro. Anonymous by default
- Pro is tied to the Apple Account purchase receipt. Restore Purchases brings back Pro, custom tones, and the day's usage count on any reinstall or new device
- Data deletion is built into the app (Settings, Delete data)

## Pricing
- Free: 5 generations per day, 1 custom tone, no account required
- Pro (monthly or annual): 200 generations per day, up to 4 custom tones

## Company
- Operator: Anomaly Labs LLC (Washington state, USA), operating parry as a registered DBA
- Founded: April 2026
